subject: Matemática
description_pt: Calcular a probabilidade de eventos, com base na construção do espaço amostral, utilizando o princípio multiplicativo, e reconhecer que a soma das probabilidades de todos os elementos do espaço amostral é igual a 1.

components.description_pt: Definir um espaço amostral e eventos dentro do espaço amostral
components.description_en: Define a sample space and events within the sample space
components.cc_component_description: Define a sample space and events within the sample space

components.description_pt: Aplicar o Princípio Fundamental da Contagem para determinar o número de resultados
components.description_en: Apply the Fundamental Counting Principle to determine the number of outcomes

components.description_pt: Calcular a probabilidade de um evento dado usando seu espaço amostral
components.description_en: Calculate the probability of a given event using its sample space
components.cc_component_description: Use a uniform probability model to find the probability of simple events

components.description_pt: Verificar que a soma das probabilidades de todos os resultados em um espaço amostral é igual a 1
components.description_en: Verify that the sum of probabilities of all outcomes in a sample space equals 1
components.cc_component_description: Develop a probability model and use it to find probabilities of events

cc_matches.description: Describe events as subsets of a sample space (the set of outcomes) using characteristics (or categories) of the outcomes, or as unions, intersections, or complements of other events ("or," "and," "not").

Develop a uniform probability model by assigning equal probability to all outcomes, and use the model to determine probabilities of events. *For example, if a student is selected at random from a class, find the probability that Jane will be selected and the probability that a girl will be selected.*

Develop a probability model and use it to find probabilities of events. Compare probabilities from a model to observed frequencies; if the agreement is not good, explain possible sources of the discrepancy.

unlocks.description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas de contagem cuja resolução envolva a aplicação do princípio multiplicativo.
Reconhecer, em experimentos aleatórios, eventos independentes e dependentes e calcular a probabilidade de sua ocorrência, nos dois casos.
Resolver e elaborar problemas que envolvem o cálculo de probabilidade de eventos em experimentos aleatórios sucessivos.
